title: A required select in the action card shows one option but sends empty
evidence: A required select whose value is null or empty has no placeholder option, so the browser shows the first option as selected while state is '' and the confirm sends null.
impact: What runs is not what the person sees, which breaks rule 4 of the actions contract.
fix: Render a disabled, selected empty first option ('Choose ...') for every select whose value is empty, required or not, so the visible choice always equals the state; the required mark and the server's 422 cover a missing choice.

title: Briefing links on the new-chat screen skip the safe-link rule
evidence: row.href is rendered in a raw Link without isSafePageHref, unlike AiMarkdown, AnswerBlocks and the ActionCard result link.
impact: A briefing href pointing at /dashboard/ask-ai or carrying q or topic would still be clickable.
fix: Pass every briefing href through isSafePageHref and render the row without a link when it fails.

title: Checkbox help and error are not tied to the checkbox
evidence: The checkbox field's help and error paragraphs have no id and the input has no aria-describedby.
impact: A screen reader does not read the hint with the checkbox.
fix: Give the help and error elements ids and set aria-describedby on the input, as the Field-based controls do.

title: An assistant message can now arrive with a null payload
evidence: The server now returns an assistant message the person can no longer see (an officer who lost a module) with payload null and fixed text.
impact: Any code that reads payload fields without a guard throws and blanks the conversation.
fix: Make every read of message.payload safe for null (ChatMessage, AnswerBlocks, ReasoningDisclosure, ActionCard, Copy, the conversation list preview) and add a test that renders such a message.

title: A 429 from the chat must show its message and not retry
evidence: The server answers 429 with a JSON message both for the rate limit and for 'Wait for the current answer to finish.' (one running answer per person).
impact: A generic error or an automatic retry would hammer the limit and confuse the person.
fix: On 429 show the server's message in the inline error, keep the person's text in the composer, offer Try again only as a manual button, and never retry automatically; test both messages.
